nodes.label: Order-ahead stock override
nodes.rationale: Out-of-stock products due between today and cut-off become orderable with quantity 5; expired or later due dates switch it off.

nodes.label: Checksum verified photo backup
nodes.rationale: Apply stays locked until downloaded backup SHA-256 matches and every selected product is covered.

nodes.label: Delayed detached-photo clean-up
nodes.rationale: Only detached photos older than seven days and unused by any product can be permanently deleted.

nodes.label: SKU not in CFS: old saved code match
nodes.norm_label: sku not in cfs: old saved code match

nodes.label: Needs your decision
nodes.rationale: Unclear products remain unchanged until the user chooses a decision.

nodes.label: Live CFS stock to Shopify inventory
nodes.norm_label: live cfs stock to shopify inventory

nodes.label: CSV variant comparison and orphan deletion
nodes.norm_label: csv variant comparison and orphan deletion

nodes.label: SHA-256-confirmed photo backup zip
nodes.rationale: A live run downloads and hash-confirms a backup before detaching photos.

nodes.label: Stock Sync
nodes.rationale: The dashboard states delivery at most six weeks means IN STOCK with quantity at least two; longer means OUT OF STOCK with quantity zero.

nodes.label: Merge split Default colours
nodes.rationale: Variants for the same CFS product move into an existing real colour while SKUs, prices, stock and photos stay as they are.

nodes.label: Undo a live run
nodes.rationale: Deleted variants cannot be restored; later edits are skipped unless Overwrite is selected.

nodes.label: Downloadable undo file
nodes.rationale: Render restarts lose the server copy; a downloaded undo file can be uploaded again.
